general_information.name: UM, SORRY, DO YOU MEAN MY FULL NAME EXACTLY AS ON THE DOCUMENT? I’M NOT SURE WHAT FORMAT YOU WANT ME TO SAY IT IN… I CAN GIVE IT PIECE BY PIECE IF THAT’S EASIER.

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s been the eating thing, mostly… restrictive eating and counting calories, that sort of never really went away. I’ve been trying to restore my weight, and that’s been partway better over the past year, but I still get really stuck on body shape stuff and I avoid eating with other people. It’s kind of taken over my day, honestly.
current_concerns.goals: I want to be able to eat a meal with friends without planning it for days beforehand. That would be… a big thing for me.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born and raised in Toronto, and I was a pretty perfectionistic child, I guess. That’s the main thing I remember about it.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was high achieving through school, and the eating difficulties started in the final year… of school. That’s kind of when things began to get really stuck.
